//: Exceptions to D-8 (largest landmass only). For each country listed, every polygon with area >= minShare x the largest polygon's area is also kept. The default stays largest-only, which is what fixes France-in-the-Atlantic and the USA; list here only the archipelago states whose largest island alone is not recognisable. Each entry needs a reason. Changes by pull request; regenerate tools/preview.html and look at it.

ID.why: Kalimantan alone is a blob. Keeps Sumatra, Sulawesi, Java and Indonesian Papua.

MY.why: East Malaysia is larger than the peninsula, but the peninsula is what people recognise. Keeps both.

NZ.why: North Island is 75% of South Island. Both or it is not New Zealand.

JP.why: Keeps Hokkaido, Kyushu and Shikoku (8.2%) alongside Honshu.

PH.why: Luzon alone is unrecognisable. Keeps Mindanao and the larger Visayas.

GB.why: Northern Ireland (6.7%) is part of the UK's outline.

IT.why: Italy without Sicily and Sardinia looks wrong to everyone.

DK.why: Keeps Zealand and Funen with Jutland.

FJ.why: Vanua Levu is half of Viti Levu; both or it is one blob.
